plain_text:
Loneliness and lack of contact can
have long-term health effects
semantic_text: Loneliness and lack of contact can have long-term health effects

plain_text:
YOUR HEALTH Social isolation, or being physically
separated from others, can lead to loneliness and
increased stress, especially during a pandemic.
semantic_text: YOUR HEALTH Social isolation, or being physically separated from others, can lead to loneliness and increased stress, especially during a pandemic.

plain_text:
Loneliness has been associated with higher rates
of depression, anxiety, and suicide. It can also
weaken our immune systems, which help protect us
from getting sick. Luckily, understanding stress and
loneliness and how to manage them can help.
semantic_text: Loneliness has been associated with higher rates of depression, anxiety, and suicide. It can also weaken our immune systems, which help protect us from getting sick. Luckily, understanding stress and loneliness and how to manage them can help.

plain_text:
While some stress is normal, too much of it can interfere
with daily activities, relationships, and work. Symptoms of
stress and anxiety include:
semantic_text: While some stress is normal, too much of it can interfere with daily activities, relationships, and work. Symptoms of stress and anxiety include:

plain_text:
■ Feeling irritable, restless, and on edge
■ Feeling overwhelmed and unmotivated
■ Muscle tension
■ Fatigue or tiredness
■ Difficulty concentrating
semantic_text: ■ Feeling irritable, restless, and on edge ■ Feeling overwhelmed and unmotivated ■ Muscle tension ■ Fatigue or tiredness ■ Difficulty concentrating

plain_text:
To combat stress, make sure to eat a diet full of heart-
healthy fruits, vegetables, and grains. Get enough sleep (for
adults, that is usually between 7 and 8 hours) and seek out
physical activity.
semantic_text: To combat stress, make sure to eat a diet full of heart-healthy fruits, vegetables, and grains. Get enough sleep (for adults, that is usually between 7 and 8 hours) and seek out physical activity.

plain_text:
Connecting with nature can lower levels of stress and
reduce symptoms of anxiety and depression. A walk or bike
ride may make you feel better and stay physically fit. Just 30
minutes of physical activity a day can make a big difference.
semantic_text: Connecting with nature can lower levels of stress and reduce symptoms of anxiety and depression. A walk or bike ride may make you feel better and stay physically fit. Just 30 minutes of physical activity a day can make a big difference.

plain_text:
Remember to wear a mask even when you are outside. Also,
keep 6 feet of space between yourself and people who do
not live in your home.
semantic_text: Remember to wear a mask even when you are outside. Also, keep 6 feet of space between yourself and people who do not live in your home.

plain_text:
Avoiding in-person social gatherings will help keep you
and others safe. But you can stay in touch with people
in other ways:
semantic_text: Avoiding in-person social gatherings will help keep you and others safe. But you can stay in touch with people in other ways:

plain_text:
■ Connect with loved ones through online games, video
calls, or messaging apps.
■ Look online for virtual exercise classes, religious
services, and cultural events.
■ Try at-home, guided yoga, mindfulness, or
meditation through a mobile app.
■ Consider adopting a pet. Pets can provide comfort
and lower blood pressure, according to the National
Institute on Aging.
